name: caps-require-blocker
description: Capability filter in require mode replaces the entire tree with a single blocking FallbackPrompt. Any unsupported feature at any node triggers a hard block — the authored content is discarded and the client sees only the upgrade prompt. This fixture asserts cross-engine byte-equality (Bun + Go) for the require path, completing the graceful/warn/require triple that Epic 25b slice 3 established for fixtures 12 and 13. See Epic 25b slice 3, task 25b.11.
